nodes.label:
Eve Surface Contract
CultMesh -> AquariumUiDocument
nodes.detail: Browser Eve is the reference renderer. Fensalir consumes the same provider-owned surface document and lowers it into AquariumUiDocument. Provider repos own state and command semantics; Fensalir owns DirectWrite/Direct2D rendering, focus, keyboard, pointer dispatch, and overlay timing.

nodes.label:
DirectWriteOverlay
D3D11-on-12 Direct2D
nodes.detail: Draws Eve panels after the D3D12 scene. Existing Fensalir mechanism: DirectWriteOverlay.Render(frame, debugUi, clientUiPanels, performanceText).

nodes.label:
AquariumUiDocument
panels and controls
nodes.detail: First lowering target for shared Eve documents: readouts, buttons, toggles, sliders, options, text boxes, tree items, and detail panes.

nodes.label:
Field Reservoir
engine timing witness
nodes.detail: Fensalir remains a field/evidence engine. Eve surface rendering must stay overlay/client UI; it must not become another field-truth path.

nodes.label:
Program Output
shared D3D12 texture
nodes.detail: The program-output texture is external publication. Eve UI controls it; the resolved HDR scene and shared texture publication stay renderer-owned.

nodes.label:
Command Sink
Eve/CultNet outbound
nodes.detail: The first implementation cut needs a provider command sink so Direct2D control activation sends the same command messages as browser, iOS, and Android.

nodes.label:
Parity Probe
browser reference fixture
nodes.detail: Recorded surface fixtures should render in browser and Fensalir with comparable hierarchy, selection, controls, and detail text before provider-specific polish.
